name: Stage 24:3: Kvarntorp to Svalboviken
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24:3, Kvarntorp to Svalboviken.
utilities: Kvarntorp and Svalboviken have parking/access context, but direct public transport is weak. Expect rural road walks from stops and verify Sörmlandstrafiken or prebooked rural traffic before relying on it.

Sandviken is the strongest on-stage facility cluster, with officially listed shelter, dry toilets, rubbish bins, swimming and good tent places. Bodavik is the second strong rest/overnight node with swimming, masonry fireplace, rubbish bin and good tent places, but facilities are confirmed while the exact pin is approximate.

No reliable shop, restaurant, toilet, tap, bin, or direct public transport was verified at Svalboviken. Sörmlandstrafiken line 29-style corridor stops may help with Näshulta/Svalboviken access, but they require road walks and live timetable checks. Österby Camping and Magdakullan are useful off-route seasonal/service contexts rather than trail guarantees.
waterSources: Two official natural springs are listed: shortly after Sandviken and before/near Goffars hage. Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee water quality or availability, so filter/boil/treat both and carry backup.

Lake water from Näshultasjön and nearby lakes is natural/untested. A hiker report from 2019 found several springs in this area dry and could not rely on Kvarntorp-area water, so carry enough water in dry periods.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official/Naturkartan distance is 11.5 km. OSM relation 9631289 is tagged distance=11.5 km and relation analysis measures about 11.1 km, while local/third-party tracks can be about 10.6-10.8 km; use official 11.5 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 24:3 as the standalone Kvarntorp-Svalboviken branch. Keep 24:2, stage 24, Kvarntorp parking, Fålludden/Sandviken/Bodavik parking access, Svalbovikens badplats, Trollberget viewpoint spur, Österby Camping, Näshulta kyrka transit and Magdakullan as separate context rather than core stage geometry.
Official difficulty is medelsvår. Treat as moderate but not technical: forest and lake walking, pasture/stiles, gravel sections, ravines/streams, viewpoints and some short climbs.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 pass. A 2026-04-23 official comment reported good signing, easy wayfinding, many lake rest spots, beautiful pastures and only one short clearcut. Older beaver/cattle/gravel observations are seasonal/historical rather than current faults.

The first kilometres pass through Kvarntorp nature reserve. Do not damage trees, shrubs, plants, ground, stones or bedrock, especially by fire, and do not disturb cultural/natural features. No explicit camping ban was found in the page text, but reserve fire/damage rules apply and full legal decisions or posted signs govern details. Eskilstuna showed no formal fire ban during the 2026-04-27 pass, while county pages showed a forest-fire-risk signal, so treat open fires conservatively even without a ban.

Good tent places are officially listed at Sandviken and Bodavik. The route also passes cow pasture after Sandviken and low-volume rural/gravel roads at Fålludden, Heden/Bodavik and near Svalboviken; keep dogs leashed, close gates, give livestock room, and walk visibly on road sections. Do not add a Sandviken fireplace, Bodavik toilet/shelter, Kvarntorp toilet/bin/tap, Svalboviken toilet/bin/tap/shop, or potable tap claim; none were verified from official/OSM/service sources.
